rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for training, including the act of practising or developing skills.

example.english: I have to do training after work every day.
example.traditional: 我每日放工都要做訓練。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 fong3 gung1 dou1 jiu3 zou6 fan3 lin6

rows.note: Use this for organized instruction or skills training, especially for employees or professional groups.

example.english: The company will arrange training for new colleagues next month.
example.traditional: 公司下個月會安排培訓畀新同事。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 on1 paai4 pui4 fan3 bei2 san1 tung4 si6
